decisions.decision: Keep raw TOC capture separate from verified inventory resolutions.
decisions.reason: Source discrepancies must remain auditable; canonicalization consumes SOURCE-INVENTORY.json as the effective inventory rather than silently rewriting source evidence.

decisions.decision: Do not duplicate concepts solely because the same grammar topic reappears at a higher CEFR level.
decisions.reason: The grammar contract defines concept identity semantically; source chapters and learner lessons preserve level/source identity separately.

decisions.decision: Model regular present-tense person/number endings as one concept; orthographic/stem-ending variants are rules/pattern notes, not separate concepts.
Represent Wo+Dativ versus Wohin+Akkusativ as a contrast within one Wechselpräpositionen concept; contractions are patterns attached to the same concept.

Do not over-merge this B1 chapter into the later B2 concept for relative pronouns in Nominativ/Akkusativ/Dativ. This chapter primarily teaches nominative relative pronouns plus verb-final relative-clause structure.
Represent finite-verb position, Satzklammer and verb-first sentence types as related rules under one simple-sentence word-order concept rather than separate chapter-shaped concepts.
Represent tense forms as a structured TENSE_FORMATION matrix under one Vorgangspassiv concept; von/durch/mit complements remain rule-level distinctions.

Represent argument remapping and connector/preposition transformations as structured transformation rules under one nominalization concept; individual lexical nominalizations are examples, not separate concepts.

open_decisions: After all six pilots are structurally captured, verify whether prerequisite and related-concept links can be expressed without adding contract fields.
Do not mass-produce remaining chapters until the six-type pilot confirms the contract can represent rules, patterns, exercises and provenance without loss.
